pose_constraints.posture: Strictly vertical 'Pillar' stance; standing robustly on hind legs, head held high and slightly tilted back to display the crown of spikes.
pose_constraints.orientation: Direct 0-degree head-on frontal view. The entire spiky crown is centered and prominent.
pose_constraints.camera_angle: Low-angle 'Hero' shot, looking up to emphasize the impressive height and intricate details of the cranial spikes.
pose_constraints.body_logic: Robust torso and short tail are completely occluded by the chest and thick neck. Forelimbs tucked close. Silhouette width max 260px.
pose_constraints.framing_note: The longest, most prominent spikes on the back of the skull should extend highest, creating a distinctive, jagged crown silhouette.

character_details.expression: Fierce but with a hint of playful determination; large, expressive eyes with a subtle glint.
character_details.texture: Thick, pebbly, leathery skin with clean, sharp-edged, stylized spikes. Color: Deep forest green body with a contrasting, sun-bleached bone-white dome and vibrant, blood-orange spikes.
features: Massive, domed skull adorned with numerous long, sharp spikes and smaller bony nodes.

environmental_details.ground: Damp, dark soil with scattered fallen leaves and woody debris, characteristic of the Hell Creek floodplains.
flora: Dense undergrowth of stylized ferns and large-leafed flowering plants in the soft-focus background, suggesting a temperate forest.
environmental_details.sky: Overcast, humid Late Cretaceous sky with soft, diffused light, highlighting the intricate details of the spikes.
environmental_details.lighting: High-key 'Sunny Exposed Cinematic' lighting, with top-down light emphasizing the texture and sharp definition of the spikes, creating dynamic shadows.
